# Case 12: uncited universal assertion

Skill: write-related-work, write-introductions
Expected gates: G-SH-C, G-RW-claim
Language: en

Snippet:

> Reward shaping cannot guarantee hard constraints in any setting, and all prior learning-based schedulers therefore violate deadlines.

Why it fails: the universal and negative claims carry no claim type, no citation, and no stated premise. The first half is a consequence of the definition and needs its premise; the second half is a literature claim and needs bounded wording.
